operating_rules: Use start/end frame feature in AI video generators (Cling 2.1) for seamless multi-shot transitions
6-component prompting formula for Nano Banana: subject + action + environment + art style + lighting + details
Always specify technical details (lens type, camera model, film stock) for photography-grade AI images instead of generic descriptors
Portrait photography requires dramatic window lighting (rim light specification), not soft ambient lighting
Product photography needs macro lens sharpness detail specification or watch face becomes soft/unfocused
Architectural visualization demands golden hour timing specification (not arbitrary) for professional appeal
Street photography prompts must specify candid moment and genuine expression to avoid artificial/staged look
Avoid 'nice lighting' generic phrasing; instead specify dramatic side lighting, window light filtering, etc.
Keep less pictures in mood board (16-30) for color coherence; more pictures (50-100) for color diversity
Lower stylize value (40-60 range) overrides mood board color palette when you need different colors than board suggests
Add successful generations back into mood board to improve color diversity in future generations
Maintain natural fabric drape and body proportions in AI clothing replacements (not impossible physics)
Use negative prompting to isolate and remove dominant colors from mood board influence
Test mood boards with style raw parameter for different (sometimes better) results than standard
Create boards with different aspect ratios (wide/vertical/square mix) to help AI generation variety
Boards with text-heavy images produce better text-inclusion in new generated images
Use remix strong button (change only subject, keep style) for consistent style continuation
Void prompts (symbols instead of words) test true essence of mood board style over subject
Use dip instead of profile when mood board code fails (workaround)
Use dp done in prompt to turn off personalization for single generation
Use stylize 1000 to heavily emphasize mood board style (warning: prompt gets ignored more)
Use stylize 400 as good balance for mood board testing with void prompt

weird_gold: Meshy AI and Google Earth workflow for converting real-world architecture (Eiffel Tower) into 3D models: 360 screenshots > Nano Banana image synthesis > Meshy AI conversion = surprisingly accurate 3D asset. Process works for custom buildings too.
Style raw parameter produces noticeably different results (sometimes superior) to standard rendering on same mood board - worth testing every time despite lack of predictability.
Void prompts (just symbols like quotes) actually test true mood board style without subject interference - reveals what style the board itself has learned to produce.
Remix strong feature with one subject change + original image as style reference produces remarkably consistent style continuation for series work.
Adding successful generations back into mood board solves color diversity problems organically - board learns from its own outputs.
Lowering stylize value (40-60 range) from default 100 actually lets you override mood board color palette when you need different palette in generation.
Dip parameter works where profile fails as mood board code command (undocumented workaround).
Text-heavy mood boards produce text-capable generations more reliably than descriptive prompting alone - the image evidence of text presence matters more than text in prompt.
Macro lens specification prevents watch face softness in product photography - not mentioning it defaults to soft.
Golden hour specification in architecture is not aesthetic choice but professional appeal necessity - specific timing matters more than generic 'good light'.
Candid moment + genuine expression language prevents AI from defaulting to forced/staged street photography look.
Two-tab workflow (generate + mood board) keeps creation focused vs messy single-tab create page.
Discord /prefer option set + permutation syntax enables 3-ratio test (square/wide/vertical) in single 4-character shortcut like dip mb.
Personalization profile codes can be manually written down (no copy/paste) for sharing/reference.
